name: Diagnose medical conditions from patient symptoms
description: Users asked the assistant to diagnose specific medical conditions, interpret clinical test results, or provide preliminary treatment recommendations based on described symptoms and patient histories. They frequently presented detailed case scenarios, including acute emergencies, chronic comorbidities, and specific physiological complaints, often requesting differential diagnoses, nursing care plans, or the identification of underlying causes for their own or family members' health issues.
